figurative_meaning_en: one with a fragile or short life
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার শরীরের গঠন পাখির প্রাণের মতো ক্ষীণ।
এই ফুলের আয়ু পাখির প্রাণের মতো সংক্ষিপ্ত।
example_sentences_in_english: His constitution is as fragile as a bird's life.
The flower's lifespan is as short as a bird's life.
note: This idiom draws from the observation of birds' delicate and often short lives in Bengali folklore.
